additionalObservation.scope: Preserved old root entry uses a different bundle. No functional defect established; old bundle reproducibility is not part of the v50 passing conclusion.

limitations: Browser fixture tests use fictional accounts and synthetic shared records, not the user’s two phones.
Additional boot cases execute the actual shipped bundle with every request intercepted; no real authentication or production writes.
Firestore tests use local demo projects. SDK disableNetwork/enableNetwork exercises suspended reads and reconciliation, not physical mobile packet loss.
Exploration showed that SDK disableNetwork did not reliably prevent transaction traffic in this harness, so that assumption was removed; no claim of an offline transaction rejection is made.
Native iPhone speech quality, OS keyboard behavior, background suspension and real network timing remain outside this test environment.
